chunks: From whatever way his death reaches him.
ai.seo_question: What does Nahj al-Balagha say about the unexpected nature of death?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s sermons and sayings, this phrase underscores the unpredictability of divine decree (ajal), reminding believers that death arrives not by chance but by God’s precise timing, often from unexpected sources. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on constant readiness (mawt) and detachment from worldly attachments, as one’s lifespan is fixed yet its arrival is concealed. It serves as a spiritual reminder to align one’s actions with divine will, knowing that the end is certain but its manner is unknown.
